note: On the West River in Jamaica, with the Salmon Hole swimming area and the West River Trail; the river-edge camping is the Loop C lean-tos, and the tent/RV sites are inland. Access is over the Depot Street bridge, posted at 8 tons with no exceptions. Most RV sites fit only a 20-ft rig. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA + 2026 map: 41 tent/RV, max 30 ft (only T15/T16/T25/T27; the rest 20 ft); no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump. Riverbank-campsite claim removed (only Loop C lean-tos on the river). Not waterfront kept. Season manual not overwritten (10-14 vs 2026's Oct 12). Phone 802-874-4600 (stored blank). Bridge 8-ton limit reported. Pin at entrance ~400 m from loops.
flags: FIT: only 4 sites (T15, T16, T25, T27, all 30 ft) take more than 20 ft on the booking site; every other tent/RV site lists 20 ft. Under the 23-ft rule the park keeps four usable sites - flag for the reviewer (kept: some sites fit).

ROAD (agency's own wording, reported, not a drop): the park page says the Depot Street Bridge has an 8-ton weight limit 'with no exceptions' and 'Please be sure the total weight of your vehicle and RV does not exceed the limit.' A 23-ft rig at 11,000 lb GVWR (5.5 tons) passes. Also on the page: a 3-night minimum for the September paddling weekend, booked by phone only, and a West River Trail landslide closure.

WATERFRONT / NOTE CLAIM: the old note's 'riverside campsites directly on the riverbank' is not supported. The agency Map & Guide puts only the Loop C lean-tos (Ash, Alder, Birch, Maple, Pine, Spruce, Oak) along the West River; every tent/RV site (Loops A/B) is inland behind the day-use parking and the Salmon Hole area. Removed; not waterfront kept.

PIN: stored 43.1057,-72.7733 (= Google's place pin) is at the entrance/office by the Depot Street bridge, ~400 m south-east of the camping loops (under canopy). Approximate loop location 43.1092,-72.7743 (inland of the long Salmon Hole parking clearing) - recommend a move there only if the reviewer can confirm it; I could not place numbered sites.
SEASON: stored manual 05-15/10-14 (read 2026-10-20) not overwritten. The page says 'Third weekend in May through the second Monday in October' - 2026: May 15/16 to October 12; 10-14 matches no year.
PHONE: stored blank; the park page and Google give 802-874-4600 (Google 4.8, 378 reviews).
